final_message:
Done. The full test suite passes (`6 passed`).

I fixed two bugs in `lrucache/cache.py`:

1. **`get` didn't refresh recency** — despite the docstring saying both `get` and `put` count as a "use", `get` never moved the accessed key to the most-recently-used end. Added `self._data.move_to_end(key)` on a successful read.

2. **`put` evicted on in-place updates** — the eviction check ran unconditionally, so updating an already-present key at full capacity would evict an innocent entry even though the entry count wasn't growing. Now it only evicts when the key is new (`key not in self._data`).

I also wrote `SOLUTION.md` explaining both root causes. I did not touch anything under `tests/` and made no git commits.
